items.question: What are your operating hours?
items.answer: Our clinic is open Monday-Saturday from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Emergency services operate 24/7.

items.question: Do you accept health insurance?
items.answer: Yes, we accept major local and international health insurance providers. Please check with billing for details.

items.question: How do I cancel my appointment?
items.answer: You can cancel or reschedule by calling our helpdesk at least 24 hours prior to your slot.
